suggested_requirements.text: The system shall display an introductory movie upon startup.
The system shall allow the user to skip the introductory movie via a mouse click.
The system shall provide a main menu with options to start the game, view help, or visit the team website.
The system shall present a series of multiple-choice fraction questions to the user.
The system shall provide feedback to the user upon selecting an answer to a fraction question.
The system shall allow the user to retry a question if the initial answer is incorrect.
The system shall adapt the storyline based on user performance at critical points.
The system shall calculate and display the user's final score at the end of the game.
The system shall provide an option to quit or restart the game at the end of the session.
The system shall provide an administrative interface to update fraction questions.
The system shall require a password for access to the question updater interface.
The system shall validate administrative input for completeness and context before saving updates.
The system shall store updated question data in a file on the web server.
The system shall provide a menu of links to other math-related projects.
The system shall accept all user input via mouse clicks only.
The system shall be accessible via a web browser supporting Macromedia Flash 5 and JavaScript.
The system shall allow the main game to be playable within a few minutes over a standard modem connection.
The system shall inherit security properties from the host web browser.
The system shall be designed with a graphical interface appropriate for sixth-grade students.
The system shall be available over the Internet via the S2S website.
